title: Domain on clientHold — no DNS resolution
description: Registrar has placed clientHold on domain, preventing all DNS resolution. No A, MX, TXT, or CNAME records resolve.
risks: No services accessible; engagement cannot proceed without domain activation.
attack_vectors: None — domain does not resolve; no targets to attack.
poc: dig cybacrest.com A +short (empty); whois shows clientHold status
proof_of_existence: Domain status: clientHold. All subdomain enumeration (crt.sh, subfinder, brute-force) returned empty. No A/MX/TXT/CNAME records found. No web server, CDN, WAF, or email infra detected...
remediation: Client should activate domain or confirm if clientHold is intentional.

title: DNSSEC unsigned — future spoofing risk
description: Domain has no DNSSEC signing. Once activated, DNS responses can be spoofed without detection.
risks: DNS cache poisoning and spoofing attacks possible once domain goes live.
attack_vectors: Once domain activates, attacker can spoof DNS responses to redirect traffic.
proof_of_existence: DNSSEC unsigned — no DNSKEY records found. Domain vulnerable to DNS spoofing once activated...
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing at registrar before domain goes live.

title: Very new domain with minimal history
description: Domain created March 2026 (~5 months old). No historical DNS records, no SSL certificates, no passive DNS footprint.
risks: Limited threat intelligence; domain may be parked or under development.
proof_of_existence: Domain created March 2026. No historical SSL certs in crt.sh. No passive DNS records. Google Domains nameservers, Squarespace registrar...
remediation: Monitor domain for activation; re-run full recon when live.

title: Domain on clientHold — DNS suspended
description: Registrar placed clientHold on domain, suspending all DNS resolution. No A/AAAA/MX/TXT/CNAME records exist.
risks: No services accessible; domain effectively dead. No attack surface present.
attack_vectors: None — domain is non-functional. Potential for domain takeover if registration lapses.
poc: dig cybacrest.com ANY +short — no records returned
proof_of_existence: Domain status: clientHold. No DNS records found across all queries. All subdomain enumeration returned NXDOMAIN.
remediation: Confirm with client whether clientHold is expected; monitor for reactivation.

title: DNSSEC unsigned
description: Domain has no DNSSEC signing. Once activated, vulnerable to DNS spoofing/cache poisoning.
risks: Future DNS spoofing attacks possible once domain goes live.
attack_vectors: DNS cache poisoning, spoofing of records when domain becomes active.
proof_of_existence: DNSSEC: Unsigned. No DNSKEY records returned.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC before domain goes live.

title: Very new domain with no historical footprint

risks: No prior infrastructure to analyze; no attack surface to test.

poc: crt.sh query for cybacrest.com — 0 results; passive DNS — 0 results
proof_of_existence: Created March 2026. No SSL certificates found in crt.sh. No passive DNS footprint.

title: cybacrest.com DNS suspended with clientHold status
description: Domain registrar has applied clientHold status, suspending DNS resolution. Domain is effectively offline.
risks: Domain inactive — limited attack surface via traditional web/DNS vectors
attack_vectors: If clientHold is lifted, previously configured records may expose stale cloud resource pointers
proof_of_existence: Domain has clientHold DNS status (suspended registrar). No live web assets found.

title: Firebase Hosting sites not found across all subdomains
description: All Firebase Hosting subdomains (cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev) return 'Site Not Found'.
risks: Firebase hosting decommissioned — no live web app to attack
attack_vectors: If Firebase project still exists, RTDB or Storage may remain publicly accessible via API keys
proof_of_existence: Firebase Hosting returns 'Site Not Found' across all subdomains (cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev)
remediation: Verify Firebase project deletion in GCP console; check RTDB and Storage permissions

title: S3 buckets non-existent — potential subdomain takeover risk
description: 5 S3 buckets tested (cybacrest, -prod, -dev, -assets, -backup) all return NoSuchBucket. 8 additional buckets from scope unverified.
risks: If DNS CNAME records still point to these bucket names, attacker can register them for subdomain takeover
attack_vectors: Register non-existent S3 bucket with matching name, configure for phishing/content injection if DNS resolves to it
proof_of_existence: All tested buckets return NoSuchBucket. cybacrest, cybacrest-prod, cybacrest-dev, cybacrest-assets, cybacrest-backup all 404.
remediation: Remove dangling DNS CNAME records pointing to deleted S3 buckets

title: Azure Blob and GCS storage targets unverified
description: Approved scope includes 3 Azure Blob endpoints and 1 GCS endpoint. Results may exist in raw/ folder but were not reviewed.
risks: Unverified cloud storage may contain exposed data or be vulnerable to takeover
attack_vectors: Check each endpoint for public container listing, anonymous blob access, or non-existent resource takeover
poc: Not yet verified — results may be in raw/ folder from omitted commands
proof_of_existence: Azure: cybacrestprod.blob.core.windows.net, cybacrestdev.blob.core.windows.net, cybacrest.blob.core.windows.net. GCS: cybacrest.storage.googleapis.com. Results in omitted 35 commands.
remediation: Review raw/ folder output; verify each endpoint status

title: crt.sh historical SSL certificates not queried
description: Certificate Transparency logs via crt.sh API have not been queried. Historical certs may reveal forgotten subdomains.
risks: Previously active subdomains may have lingering infrastructure or exposed services
attack_vectors: Query crt.sh?q=cybacrest.com&output=json, extract subdomain names from certificate SANs, probe discovered hosts
proof_of_existence: ARIA recommended crt.sh check but did not execute. Historical subdomains remain undiscovered.
remediation: Execute crt.sh query immediately in next recon loop
